{{Gate}}
This page tracks the development document '''"Rawness & Mortality"''' (10 July 2026, revision 2, keyed to Lore Bible v26.5) — gate material on death, brutality, and mortality in the Emberwold books. '''Nothing here is canon until it passes the author's gate.''' The full document lives in the project repository.

== The method (rules 1–13, gate-ready) ==
Violence traces to a philosophy applied completely; the mystery makes the choice unjudgeable; the body and grief are real while the explanation stays uncertain; no executioners — institutions kill through procedure, consensus, weather, and stillness; every victim has a name and mourners; every house gets to be right; every significant death does at least two kinds of work; the shock test; sexuality changes power or stays offstage; '''the elevens stay frozen'''; ordinary death outnumbers political, political outnumbers mythic; the sources carry the brutality; and brutality never solves the mystery.
